name: deck-data-in-templates
body:
Deck-wide `kalide.yaml` values are exposed to templates under the reserved `deck` context: `{{.deck.title}}`, `{{.deck.author}}` and `{{.deck.date}}` for the config values, and the author's arbitrary properties under `{{index .deck.properties "<key>"}}` (or `{{.deck.properties.<key>}}` when the key is a plain identifier). `title` is always present (it is required); `author` and `date` are empty strings when omitted; `properties` is always present as a map (possibly empty). Values keep the type they had in `properties:` (deck-properties): strings are escaped text, numbers/booleans/dates are typed values; nothing here is pre-rendered as HTML.
AC: a layout with `{{.deck.title}}`/`{{.deck.author}}`/`{{.deck.date}}` renders the configured values; `{{index .deck.properties "audience"}}` renders the declared property; an author with no `properties:` renders with an empty `.deck.properties`.
